thread:
DeployBot: Heads-up — we have a scheduled ops change affecting control-plane routing tomorrow 02:00–03:30 UTC. No model-serving nodes will be drained, but there will be a short window where routing reconciliation is paused. Expect a quick spike in error-rate traces while the routing table reconciles. Posting this in advance for on-call planning. :bell:

IncidentBot: Automated note — page policy: if errors > 5% for 3m for a customer-facing route, page eng-oncall. Will not page for internal-only routes. See runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/routing-reconcile

Devon: Thanks — tagging eng-oncall rotation for handoff. I'm planning to take 02:00–02:45 UTC then hand to Maria for 02:45–03:30. Can someone confirm customer comms owner? @Sarah? @Ajay?

Maria: I can take the second half. Quick note: we've had a paid-customer in ap-southeast with a high-sensitivity SLA that requested no changes between 01:30–02:30 UTC. Any chance we can nudge to 03:00–04:30? That avoids overlap.

Ajay: We should avoid hitting that SLA window. Proposal: shift the maintenance +30m later (02:30–04:00 UTC). That keeps a 30m buffer. Anyone object?

Devon: +1 on shifting. Operationally fine for the runtime team. We'll update the status page and the customer email. Who will update the portal and the status page? I can push a draft to the status-page queue.

Sarah: I'll own customer-facing comms. Draft below — please copy-edit:

```
Subject: Brief control-plane scheduling: short routing reconciliation on <date> (expected 90m)

Hi —

We're scheduling a short control-plane routing reconciliation on <date> starting at 02:30 UTC for ~90 minutes. During this time you may see transient errors or slightly higher latency for a few routes while we reconcile routing tables. There is no expected impact to model payloads or inference throughput beyond temporary retries. If you rely on a strict SLA in the 01:30–03:30 UTC window, please reply and we'll coordinate.

We'll post live updates on status.redwood.ai and follow up when complete.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Ops
```

Ajay: Edit suggestion: add explicit remediation bullet — "If you see >10% errors for more than 5 minutes, open a support ticket and we'll prioritize a hotfix". Also include link to support form.

Sarah: Good call, added.

Devon: I'll queue the status page pre-incident message. Proposed content for status page (short):

```
Status: Notice — brief routing reconciliation in progress
Impact: Transient request errors and increased latency for affected routes. No data loss.
Window: 02:30–04:00 UTC
Next update: in 15 minutes or on change.
```

Maria: Who will be the live updater? We should ensure the person updating the status page is not the same as the responder to avoid task conflicts.

Devon: I can trigger the initial "maintenance scheduled" notification 90m before start (that's now) and post the "in progress" at 02:30. Maria can do live updates during the second half (03:00+). Sarah can post the customer email after we confirm the new window.

IncidentBot: Reminder — page rule check: ensure on-call notifications are enabled for eng-oncall and eng-sre aliases. If you need escalation to paging-ops, mention it explicitly.

Maria: Quick handoff checklist (internal):
- Confirm pre-checks: all router health >= 98%
- Preserve KV-cache targets — do not evict unless failover
- Monitoring: set a threshold alert: errors > 5% sustained for 3m -> page
- Status page owner: Maria (03:00–04:00 UTC)
- Customer comms: Sarah (pre & post)

Devon: Pushing a small script to runbook to automate the pre-checks. Command for manual status update (curl):

```
curl -X POST https://status.redwood.ai/api/v1/incidents \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STATUS_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"Routing reconciliation","status":"investigating","message":"Transient errors possible. Window 02:30–04:00 UTC"}'
```

Ajay: Thx. One last ask: please add a short internal blurb we can paste into dedicated-customer Slack channels for those customers who opted into proactive comms.

Sarah: Internal blurb draft:

"We are performing a planned control-plane routing reconcile on <date>, 02:30–04:00 UTC. You may see transient errors or retries. No model-serving nodes will be drained. Ops will monitor and provide updates on status.redwood.ai. Contact support if you see >10% error rate sustained."

Devon: LGTM. I'll update the schedule now and send a calendar invite to eng-oncall, eng-sre, and customer-success. @Maria please confirm you'll be available for 03:00–04:00.

Maria: Confirmed. :white_check_mark:

Sarah: I'll queue the customer email to go out 60m before start and hold if any last-minute changes. Sending a preview to #customer-success for review.

Devon: Thanks everyone. Final note: if we see cascading errors tied to the routing reconciliation, fallback plan is immediate rollback of the routing pause (re-enable reconciliation) and promote the previous routing snapshot. Runbook steps in the channel link above. :rotation:

Ajay: :thumbsup:

DeployBot: Scheduled maintenance window updated in ops-scheduler to 02:30–04:00 UTC. Calendar invites sent.
